_readme: Copy to env/dev.json and env/prod.json (git-ignored), fill real values. Client IDs come from the Arul Google Cloud project (arul-prod-db4f8, project number 1083884444243) — never reuse Pakiza's.
_firebase: "true" is the norm — env/dev.json and env/prod.json both set it, and every real build ships Crashlytics + Performance + GA4. It is "false" here only because android/app/google-services.json is git-ignored: a fresh clone must add its own file first, then flip this to "true". Enabling it without the file makes Firebase.initializeApp() fail.
